text:
maria: Quick sync — we have two teams planning release branch cuts this afternoon (Core and Platform). Risk: branch-name collision when automation runs if both call it `release/1.18`. Can we coordinate a cutover window and ownership? :wave:

alex: Ack. Can we do a 60-min exclusive window? I can shift ours to 3pm-4pm PT. Which automation creates branch now? release-bot?

jonathan: We usually let release-bot create `release/*` from `main` at cut time. It will fail if branch exists. If someone creates manually, it can still be fine but ops needs to know. I'd prefer single owner + PR to protect.

lia: I can own creation for Platform at 3pm. Suggest Core takes 4pm-5pm. Also propose we use `release/1.18` for the main, and `release/1.18-rc1` or `release/1.18-plat` for any pre-cut experimental ones.

alex: SGTM. For cherry-picks/backports: please add `backport/1.18` label to PRs and ping me. For urgent PRs needed post-cut, we'll allow `hotfix/1.18.x` branches.

maria: Nice. @jonathan can you add a pre-cut checklist to the release checklist doc? Minimal: bump version, update changelog, ensure `ci/release-lock` label is clear.

jonathan: Done — PR for checklist: https://git.internal/r/infra/456 (will merge once we agree).

release-bot: Heads-up: I'm scheduled to run `branch-create` for release/1.18 at 2026-03-17T22:00:00Z unless a human owns the cut. Use `/release lock` to claim.

lia: I claimed via `/release lock release/1.18` — will create at 2026-03-17T22:00:00Z. I'll post a follow-up when branch is created. :+1:

alex: Thanks Lia. jonathan — if a PR (#1234) needs backport, can you approve with `backport/1.18` label? @maria FYI.

maria: PR #1234 is the version bump — please include that in your creation flow. And if anyone's going to create manually run: `git fetch origin && git checkout -b release/1.18 origin/main` then push.

lia: Branch created. release/1.18 -> origin/main. release-bot ran post-create job: `ci/release:bootstrap` passed. I'll open the release notes PR now.

release-bot: Automated note: branch `release/1.18` created by lia at 2923456890. CI: green. Remember to add `backport/1.18` labels to any cherry-picks.

alex: :thumbsup: I'll coordinate any backports. If collision resurfaces we can add a branch lock policy in repo for `refs/heads/release/*`.
